wins.label: Record Net Inflows
wins.evidence: BlackRock generated a record $641 billion of total net inflows in 2024, including $281 billion in the fourth quarter.

wins.label: Double-Digit Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: Full year revenue of $20.4 billion was up 14% year-over-year. Operating income of $8.1 billion was up 23% and earnings per share of $43.61, increased 15%.

wins.label: High Organic Base Fee Growth
wins.evidence: 7% annualized organic base fee growth in the fourth quarter, our highest in 3 years. Full year organic base fee growth was 4%.

wins.label: Successful Acquisitions
wins.evidence: BlackRock's private markets and alternatives platform is expected to be $600 billion in client assets, a top 5 provider and over $3 billion in revenues or about 15% of 2024 revenues.

wins.label: Strong ETF Performance
wins.evidence: BlackRock’s institutional platform generated net inflows of $74 billion in 2024, led by active net inflows of $64 billion, including the funding of several large outsourcing mandates from a variety of client types.

risks.label: Interest Rate Sensitivity
risks.evidence: As you noticed, the yield curve is steepening. And so you're going to -- over the time, you're going to be benefiting by going out the curve.

risks.label: Market Volatility
risks.evidence: BlackRock is well positioned to capitalize on structural growth opportunities against a backdrop of economic and capital market evolution. We see opportunities in private markets, infrastructure, and credit.

risks.label: Regulatory Uncertainty
risks.evidence: We're working on a first-of-its-kind managed model solution with the Partners Group. We think this will simplify wealth access, offering a single subscription model product with varied allocations based on risk tolerance.

risks.label: Competition in Private Markets
risks.evidence: We've been doing work. We've been doing work. We're always doing work on product innovation.

risks.label: Integration Risk (HPS, Preqin)
risks.evidence: BlackRock's head count is expected to be higher in 2025 as a result of the planned acquisitions of Preqin and HPS.
